title: Why Meghan Markle’s $22M Celebrity Brand is Failing 👸
description: Why Meghan Markle’s $22M Celebrity Brand is Failing 👸
transcript: Why Meghan Markle's celebrity brand is struggling. Not every celebrity brand takes off. And Meghan Markle's, as ever, is a master class in how massive attention can still turn into a marketing disaster. This is the Duchess of Sussex. She had a global recognition, a Netflix show, millions of people watching, and products that initially sold out. You would think this brand would be absolutely unstoppable, but then everything started falling apart. The social content feels more like a personal lifestyle page than an actual growth engine for content. There is no massive advertising machine flooding the market. The website looks beautiful, but it is not aggressively optimized to convert, increase average order values or push subscriptions or be able to convert people at scale. The product line feels scattered. There's jam, tea, wine, candles. What are all those have to do with each other? There is no obvious hero product or clear reason customers need to come back. And then came the biggest warning sign of all. Netflix ended its investment partnership with as ever. This is absolutely shocking. They had one of the biggest media companies in the world helping launch this brand, and now Megan has to grow it independently. This is the real issue. Celebrity gets you attention does not automatically guarantee that you build in retention, recurring revenue and paid acquisition or scalable distribution. As ever did not have an awareness problem. It had a systems problem. Because even the most famous founder in the World cannot save a brand without the infrastructure to turn it into an acquisition engine that gets predictable cells.
